中文台词: 少年推开那座沉重的铁门，屋内磬静的黢黑刹时吞噬了他那渺小的身躯。
英文台词: The youth pushed open the heavy iron gate, and the profound, silent darkness within swallowed his frail frame in an instant.

中文台词: 少年眯起双眼，极力想看清屋内的情状，但除了远处的几朵飘忽不定的幽火以外，其余的一切全被漆上了一层浓稠的黑。
英文台词: He narrowed his eyes, straining to make out the interior. Yet save for a few wandering, ghostly flames flickering in the distance, all else was drowned in a thick, viscous gloom.

中文台词: 怀着难以抑制的好奇与恐惧，少年蹀躞徐行，向远处揜菼的灯火趋近。
英文台词: Driven by a mingled thrill of curiosity and dread, he paced slowly forward, stepping softly toward the distant, wavering light.

中文台词: 倏忽，他听到了两个浑厚沉雄的声音。起初声音微渺，时断时续。少年停步，侧耳细听：
英文台词: Suddenly, two deep, sonorous voices reached his ears. At first they were faint, broken and intermittent. He halted, tilting his head to listen more closely:

中文台词: 世衰道微，邪说暴行有作，臣弑其君者有之，子弑其父者有之。
英文台词: When the world declined, and true principles fell into disuse, perverse doctrines and violent deeds arose. There were instances of ministers murdering their sovereigns, and sons murdering their fathers.

中文台词: 邪说诬民，充塞仁义也。仁义充塞，则率兽食人，人将相食。吾为此惧，闲先圣之道，距杨墨，放淫辞，邪说者不得作。
英文台词: Such perverse doctrines delude the people, and block up the path of benevolence and righteousness. When benevolence and righteousness are thus blocked up, it is as if men were leading beasts to devour men, and they will be found devouring one another. I am alarmed at these things, and therefore defend the ways of the ancient sages, opposing Yang and Mo, and setting aside licentious speeches.

中文台词: 作于其心，害于其事；作于其事，害于其政。圣人复起，不易吾言矣。
英文台词: What arises in the mind, works injuriously on affairs; what works injuriously on affairs, works injuriously on government. Were a sage to arise again, he would not change my words.

中文台词: 第三位天使吹号，就有烧着的大星，好像火把从天上落下来，落在江河的三分之一和众水的泉源上。
英文台词: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

中文台词: 这星名叫「茵陈」。众水的三分之一变为茵陈；因水变苦，就死了许多人。
英文台词: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

中文台词: 谈话声音戛然而止。少年覃思罔悟，对刚才谈话的二人及其言语愈发感到好奇，便加快步调向那灯火处走去。
英文台词: The voices ceased abruptly. Puzzled and increasingly curious about the two speakers and their words, the youth quickened his pace toward the light.

中文台词: 终于，在火光的尽头，他看见了那两个他既熟稔而又陌生的人：
英文台词: At last, at the end of the glow, he beheld the two figures, at once familiar and strange to him:

中文台词: 其中一人身形高大，头顶微凹，面容庄重，衣饰朴素，带有几分栉风沐雨的憔悴感；
英文台词: One was tall of stature, with a slightly sunken crown, a solemn countenance, and plain robes, bearing the weariness of one who had journeyed far and endured much.

中文台词: 另一人的样貌普通平凡，无夺目美貌，但神色柔和而坚定，脸上显出一种饱经风霜的质感。
英文台词: The other was of common, unremarkable appearance, with no striking beauty, yet his gaze was gentle and steadfast, his face marked with the texture of a life seasoned by trials.

中文台词: 少年大骇，因为他一眼便认出了前者正是那鲁鄹邑人，而后者则是加利利拿撒勒人。
英文台词: The youth started, for he recognized at once the former as the Man of Zou from Lu, and the latter as the Man of Nazareth from Galilee.

中文台词: 「他们在这里干嘛呢？」少年心想，但不知为何，他油然生出了一种乖戾的想法：
英文台词: \"What are they doing here?\" he thought. Yet for some reason, a perverse notion rose within him:

中文台词: 他想用自己的智慧驳倒这两位德高年劭、被芸芸众生顶礼膜拜的圣人。
英文台词: he would use his own wits to refute these two sages, revered and worshipped by multitudes.

中文台词: 「他们那些胶柱鼓瑟的旧思想怎么能胜过我们的新思想呢？」少年露出一丝甜腻腻的微笑，迈步向他们走去。
英文台词: \"How can their rigid, outdated old ideas ever prevail against the thinking of our time?\" A faint, smug smile tugged at his lips as he stepped toward them.

中文台词: 喂，那个鄹邑的，还有那个加利利的，你们在这干嘛？
英文台词: Ho there, you of Zou, and you of Galilee. What are you doing here?

中文台词: 少年强装出一副恭维的笑容，尽管他知道他那放荡无理的言语已经无法掩盖他那鬼迷心窍的意志了。
英文台词: he called, forcing a smile of feigned deference, though he knew his reckless, insolent words could no longer hide his defiant, mischief-bound resolve.

中文台词: 为了审判你！
英文台词: To judge you!

中文台词: 为了审判你！
英文台词: To judge you!

中文台词: 在两位圣人身后的两侧分别走出了一位孔门儒生与一位苦行修士司祭，他们神色凛然，异口同声地说道。
英文台词: From either side behind the two sages stepped forth a Confucian Scholar and an Ascetic Monk Priest, their countenances stern, speaking as one.

中文台词: 审判…我？
英文台词: Judge… me?

中文台词: 少年错愕不已，但很快又恢复了镇定，脸上又重现出他方才糊上的笑。
英文台词: The youth was taken aback, but quickly recovered his composure, the earlier smile returning to his face.

中文台词: 你们凭何来审判我，我何罪之有？
英文台词: By what right do you judge me? What sin have I committed?

中文台词: 他歪着脑袋，详装思索，抹了露出一层哂意：
英文台词: He tilted his head, feigning thought, a flicker of mockery playing across his features.

中文台词: 是因为我没能践行你们儒家的准则呢，还是因为我不信基督？
英文台词: Is it that I have failed to live by your Confucian rules? Or because I do not believe in Christ?

中文台词: 两位圣贤正襟危坐，一言不发；从他们身后走到侧旁的孔门儒生与苦行修士司祭也正色凛然地望着他。
英文台词: The two sages sat upright and silent, while the Confucian Scholar and the Ascetic Monk Priest, having stepped to their sides, gazed at him with solemn gravity.

中文台词: 少年感到诧异，心里陡地生起一股无名火：
英文台词: The youth, surprised, felt a surge of unprovoked anger rise in his chest.

中文台词: 你们既要审判我，那便来吧！无需装神弄鬼，法官们。
英文台词: If you mean to judge me, then get on with it! No need for all this mystic posturing, judges.

中文台词: —— 第一审：物质 ——
英文台词: —— First Trial: Materialism ——

中文台词: 说我物质？你们难道不是在空谈道义？
英文台词: You call me materialistic? Is it not you who prattle on empty about morality and virtue?

中文台词: 没有果腹的食粮，人连立身都难，还谈什么精神操守？
英文台词: Without bread to fill the belly, a man can scarce stand on his own two feet—what use are spiritual principles then?

中文台词: 整个社会都在看重利益、讲求实效，我又有何不对之处？
英文台词: The whole world prizes profit and results. What wrong is there in that?

中文台词: 这世道波诡云谲，惟物质才是底气，惟钱财才有选择。
英文台词: In this treacherous, shifting world, only substance gives security, only wealth gives choice.

中文台词: 你们所谓的德行仁义、安贫乐道，你们所谓的甚于面包的石头岂能饱食终日，能遮风挡雨吗？
英文台词: Can your so-called virtue and benevolence, your praise of poverty and contentment—can your stones that are more than bread ever fill a stomach, or shelter a man from the wind and rain?

中文台词: 与其抱着空原则受苦受穷，不如凭本事挣来实打实的好日子。
英文台词: Rather than cling to empty principles and suffer in poverty, I would earn a solid, tangible good life by my own ability.

中文台词: 人往高处走，逐利本就天经地义，追寻物质何罪之有？
英文台词: Every man strives for better things. The pursuit of profit is only natural. What sin is there in seeking material comfort?

中文台词: 君子先慎乎德。有德此有人，有人此有土，有土此有财，有财此有用。
英文台词: The superior man bends his attention to the cultivation of his virtue. When virtue is there, people will come; when people are there, there will be territory; when there is territory, there will be wealth; when there is wealth, there will be the means of use.

中文台词: 德者，本也；财者，末也。外本内末，争民施夺。
英文台词: Virtue is the root; wealth is the fruit. When the root is neglected and the fruit is sought after, the people will be stirred up to contention and rapine.

中文台词: 是故财聚则民散，财散则民聚。是故言悖而出者，亦悖而入；货悖而入者，亦悖而出。
英文台词: Hence, when wealth is gathered together, the people are scattered; when wealth is scattered, the people are gathered together. Hence, when words go forth contrary to reason, they will return contrary to reason; when wealth comes in contrary to reason, it will depart contrary to reason.

中文台词: 《康诰》曰：「惟命不于常。」道善则得之，不善则失之矣。
英文台词: The Announcement to Kang says, The decree is not always the same. Good conduct obtains it; bad conduct loses it.

中文台词: 王何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣。
英文台词: Why must your Majesty use that word profit? What I have are benevolence and righteousness, and these are my only themes.

中文台词: 王曰「何以利吾国」？大夫曰「何以利吾家」？士庶人曰「何以利吾身」？
英文台词: If your Majesty says, What will profit my kingdom? the great officers will say, What will profit my family? and the scholars and common people will say, What will profit myself?

中文台词: 上下交征利而国危矣。苟为后义而先利，不夺不餍。
英文台词: Superiors and inferiors will thus strive together after profit, and the kingdom will be endangered. But if righteousness be put last, and profit be put first, they will not be satisfied without grasping the whole.

中文台词: 未有仁而遗其亲者也，未有义而后其君者也。
英文台词: Never has there been benevolence in whose heart the love of his parents was wanting. Never has there been righteousness in whose heart regard to his prince was wanting.

中文台词: 生财有大道：生之者众，食之者寡，为之者疾，用之者舒，则财恒足矣。
英文台词: There is a great way for the production of wealth: let the producers be many, and the consumers few; let the workers be active, and the spenders moderate; then wealth will always be sufficient.

中文台词: 仁者以财发身，不仁者以身发财。
英文台词: The benevolent man makes wealth advance his person; the unbenevolent man makes his person advance wealth.

中文台词: 孟献子曰：「畜马乘，不察于鸡豚；伐冰之家，不畜牛羊；百乘之家，不畜聚敛之臣。与其有聚敛之臣，宁有盗臣。」
英文台词: Meng Xian said, A minister who keeps horses and chariots will not look after poultry and pigs. A family that has stores of ice will not rear oxen and sheep. A family of a hundred chariots will not keep a minister to scrape together wealth. It is better to have a minister who robs the state, than one who scrapes together wealth.

中文台词: 此谓国不以利为利，以义为利也。
英文台词: This shows that a kingdom should not make profit its aim, but righteousness.

中文台词: 不要为自己积攒财宝在地上，地上有虫子咬，能锈坏，也有贼挖窟窿来偷；
英文台词: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

中文台词: 只要积攒财宝在天上，天上没有虫子咬，不能锈坏，也没有贼挖窟窿来偷。
英文台词: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

中文台词: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也在哪里。
英文台词: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

中文台词: 有一个财主，田产丰盛，自己心里思想说：「我的出产没有地方收藏，怎么办呢？」
英文台词: The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

中文台词: 又说：「我要这么办：要把我的仓房拆了，另盖更大的，在那里收藏我一切的粮食和财物，
英文台词: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

中文台词: 然后要对我的灵魂说：灵魂哪，你有许多财物积存，可作多年的费用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快乐吧！」
英文台词: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

中文台词: 神却对他说：「无知的人哪，今夜必要你的灵魂，你所预备的要归谁呢？」
英文台词: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

中文台词: 凡为自己积财，在神面前不富足的，也是这样。
英文台词: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

中文台词: 我实在告诉你们，财主进天国是难的。
英文台词: Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

中文台词: 我又告诉你们，骆驼穿过针的眼，比财主进神的国还容易呢。
英文台词: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

中文台词: 在人这是不能的，在神凡事都能。
英文台词: With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

中文台词: 少年放肆地笑道，眼里闪烁着轻蔑与挑衅。
英文台词: The youth laughed wildly, scorn and defiance flashing in his eyes.

中文台词: 所以说，归根结底，你们不还是不厌其烦地老调重弹着这些陈词滥调吗？
英文台词: So after all, you are just harping on the same old tired platitudes, aren't you?

中文台词: 表面上满是「君子」与「德」、「蔑财」与「心」，实际上也还是满嘴胡吣！
英文台词: All this talk of gentleman and virtue, of despising wealth and the heart—it is all nothing but empty words!

中文台词: 文犹质也，质犹文也。虎豹之鞟犹犬羊之鞟。
英文台词: Ornament is as the substance; the substance is as ornament. The skins of a tiger or a leopard stripped of their hair are no different from the skins of a dog or a sheep.

中文台词: 此乃「加利利的迦拿之酒」。
英文台词: This is the wine of Cana in Galilee.

中文台词: 空口无凭，那你们在这方面的修为又如何？
英文台词: Empty words, all of them. What of your own conduct in this regard, then?

中文台词: 孔子迁于蔡三岁，吴伐陈。楚救陈，军于城父。闻孔子在陈蔡之间，楚使人聘孔子。
英文台词: Confucius had been in Cai for three years, when Wu invaded Chen. Chu came to the relief of Chen. Hearing that Confucius was between Chen and Cai, the prince of Chu sent messengers to invite him.

中文台词: 陈蔡大夫谋曰：「孔子贤者，所刺讥皆中诸侯之疾。今楚，大国也，来聘孔子。孔子用于楚，则陈蔡用事大夫危矣。」
英文台词: The great officers of Cai and Chen took counsel together, saying, Confucius is a man of virtue. If he should be employed in Chu, then we, the great officers of Chen and Cai, should be in danger.

中文台词: 于是乃相与发徒役围孔子于野。不得行，绝粮。从者病，莫能兴。
英文台词: Thereupon they jointly sent out their followers to surround Confucius in the wilderness. He could not proceed, and his supplies of food were exhausted. His followers became ill, and were not able to rise.

中文台词: 孔子讲诵弦歌不衰。子路愠见曰：「君子亦有穷乎？」
英文台词: But Confucius continued to teach, and chant, and string his lute without ceasing. Zi Lu, full of displeasure, came to him and said, Has the superior man indeed to endure such distress?

中文台词: 孔子曰：「君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。」
英文台词: Confucius said, The superior man maintains his firmness in distress; the small man, when in distress, gives way to unbridled license.

中文台词: 楚昭王将以书社地七百里封孔子。楚令尹子西曰：「王之使使诸侯有如子贡者乎？」曰：「无有。」
英文台词: King Zhao of Chu was about to give Confucius the territory of seven hundred li. But Zi Xi, the chief minister of Chu, said to him, Has your Majesty any ambassador to the princes like Zi Gong? No, was the reply.

中文台词: 「王之辅相有如颜回者乎？」曰：「无有。」「王之将率有如子路者乎？」曰：「无有。」
英文台词: Has your Majesty any minister to assist you like Yan Hui? No. Has your Majesty any general like Zi Lu? No.

中文台词: 「今孔丘述三五之法，明周召之业，王若用之，则楚安得世世堂堂方数千里乎？」
英文台词: Now Confucius is setting forth the ways of the Three Kings and Five Lords. If your Majesty employ him, how shall Chu go on to possess its territory of thousands of li square, from generation to generation?

中文台词: 昭王乃止。
英文台词: On this King Zhao desisted.

中文台词: 子路问君子。子曰：「修己以安人。」
英文台词: Zi Lu asked what constituted a superior man. The Master said, He cultivates himself so as to be in a state of respectful carefulness.

中文台词: 曰：「如斯而已乎？」曰：「修己以安百姓。修己以安百姓，尧舜其犹病诸？」
英文台词: And is that all? said Zi Lu. He cultivates himself so as to give rest to all the people. To cultivate himself so as to give rest to all the people—even Yao and Shun would have found this a difficult task.

中文台词: 原壤夷俟。子曰：「幼而不孙弟，长而无述焉，老而不死，是为贼。」以杖叩其胫。
英文台词: Yuan Rang waited for him in a squatting posture. The Master said to him, In youth, you showed no respect to your elders; in manhood, you have achieved nothing; in old age, you go on living and do not die: you are a thief. And with his staff he tapped his leg.

中文台词: 当时，耶稣被圣灵引到旷野，受魔鬼的试探。他禁食四十昼夜，后来就饿了。
英文台词: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil. And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

中文台词: 那试探人的进前来，对他说：「你若是神的儿子，可以吩咐这些石头变成食物。」
英文台词: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

中文台词: 耶稣却回答说：「经上记着说：『人活着，不是单靠食物，乃是靠神口里所出的一切话。』」
英文台词: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

中文台词: 魔鬼又带他上了一座最高的山，将世上的万国与万国的荣华都指给他看，
英文台词: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

中文台词: 对他说：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把这一切都赐给你。」
英文台词: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

中文台词: 耶稣说：「撒但，退去吧！因为经上记着说：『当拜主你的神，单要事奉他。』」
英文台词: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

中文台词: 于是魔鬼离了耶稣，有天使来伺候他。
英文台词: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

中文台词: 所以我告诉你们：不要为生命忧虑吃什么，喝什么；为身体忧虑穿什么。
英文台词: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on.

中文台词: 生命不胜于饮食吗？身体不胜于衣裳吗？
英文台词: Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

中文台词: 你们看天上的飞鸟，也不种，也不收，也不积蓄在仓里，你们的天父尚且养活它。你们不比飞鸟贵重得多吗？
英文台词: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

中文台词: 你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢？
英文台词: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

中文台词: 不要爱世界和世界上的事。人若爱世界，爱父的心就不在他里面了。
英文台词: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

中文台词: 因为凡世界上的事，就像肉体的情欲，眼目的情欲，并今生的骄傲，都不是从父来的，乃是从世界来的。
英文台词: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

中文台词: 这世界和其上的情欲都要过去，惟独遵行神旨意的，是永远常存。
英文台词: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

中文台词: 少年沉思了一阵，他觉得自己理解得过于肤浅，而当他领悟到其中蕴意后，赧颜汗下。
英文台词: The youth fell silent, pondering. He had thought his own understanding shallow, but as the meaning of the words dawned on him, a flush of shame burned across his face.

中文台词: 以前，他总觉得他对物质生活孜孜以求，精神上的富足便会悄然而至。
英文台词: Once he had thought that if he strove ceaselessly for material comfort, spiritual fulfillment would follow of its own accord.

中文台词: 直到他面对现实时，自己对物质利益锱铢必较，对优越的住房、富足的餐饮、成功的事业也如他人般趋之若鹜。
英文台词: But when he faced the truth, he saw how he had haggled over every trivial gain, how he had coveted fine houses, rich food, and worldly success just like everyone else.

中文台词: 他也曾幻想着独属自己的罗特希尔德思想，可到头来却总感到一种心灵上的寂寥与空荡，感到自己迷失了什么……
英文台词: He had once dreamed of a Rothschild-like fortune of his own, yet in the end he always felt a hollow emptiness in his soul, as if something were lost…

中文台词: 但他确信，不论明里暗里，眼下伫立在他身前的两位圣人定不单单在宣扬自己的教义，此中当还有别的深意……
英文台词: Yet he knew, in his heart of hearts, that the two sages standing before him were not merely preaching their doctrines—there was a deeper meaning beneath it all.

中文台词: —— 第二审：虚无 ——
英文台词: —— Second Trial: Emptiness ——

中文台词: 少年收敛了些许矜持感，但还是保持着某种悒郁不平的态度。
英文台词: The youth had toned down some of his haughty defiance, yet there was still a sullen, resentful edge to his voice.

中文台词: 你们说我虚无、随波逐流、不冷不热？
英文台词: You call me empty, adrift, neither cold nor hot?

中文台词: 难道就因为我对住房之优越、食粮之丰盈、就业之上进等等黾勉求之就可断言我虚无吗？
英文台词: Is it simply because I strive for a good house, plenty of food, and advancement in my work that you condemn me as empty?

中文台词: 我对生活有方向感与目标，那又何谈虚无？
英文台词: I have direction and goals in my life. How can you call that emptiness?

中文台词: 就算你们为此说我物质，但你们也不能否认我为此而在精神上虚无！
英文台词: Even if you blame me for being materialistic, you cannot deny that my pursuit of these things leaves me spiritually empty!

中文台词: 鲁鄹邑来的，我知道你是想借此说我违逆你君子之道，违逆你仁义之德；
英文台词: You of Zou, I know you mean to say I transgress your way of the gentleman, your virtue of benevolence.

中文台词: 还有那远在加利利的，我也知道你是想说我因未担我们那听了蛇的挑唆，食了禁果而后能辩孰善孰恶的先祖的原罪。
英文台词: And you of far-off Galilee, I know you mean to speak of original sin—of our ancestors who listened to the serpent's temptation, ate the forbidden fruit, and came to know good and evil.

中文台词: 但你们错了，我并非没有自己的信仰，相反，我一生对我那理想的美好的生活的信念孜孜以求，矢志不渝！
英文台词: But you are wrong. It is not that I have no faith. On the contrary, I have striven all my life with unswerving devotion toward my ideal of a good life.

中文台词: 不得中道而与之，必也狂狷乎！狂者进取，狷者有所不为也。
英文台词: Men who hold fast the middle course, but will not in all things come up to it, must at least be of two classes—the enterprising and the strictly reserved.

中文台词: 过我门而不入我室，我不憾焉者，其惟乡原乎！乡原，德之贼也。
英文台词: But there are those who pass my door and do not enter my house, and whom I do not regret not having. They are the village worthies! The village worthies are the thieves of virtue.

中文台词: 恶似而非者：恶莠，恐其乱苗也；恶佞，恐其乱义也；恶利口，恐其乱信也；
英文台词: There are things which seem right, but are not right. There are weeds which resemble grain, and are feared for confounding the grain.

中文台词: 恶郑声，恐其乱乐也；恶紫，恐其乱朱也；恶乡原，恐其乱德也。
英文台词: There are the songs of Zheng which are feared for confounding the graver music. There are the purple which are feared for confounding the true red. There are the village worthies who are feared for confounding virtue.

中文台词: 君子和而不同，小人同而不和。
英文台词: The superior man is affable, but not adulatory; the mean man is adulatory, but not affable.

中文台词: 子贡问曰：「乡人皆好之，何如？」子曰：「未可也。」
英文台词: Zi Gong asked, saying, What do you think of a man who is loved by all his fellow-villagers? The Master said, I will not tell you that.

中文台词: 「乡人皆恶之，何如？」子曰：「未可也。不如乡人之善者好之，其不善者恶之。」
英文台词: And what do you think of one who is hated by all his fellow-villagers? The Master said, I will not tell you that. It is not so good as that the good men of the village love him, and the bad men hate him.

中文台词: 叶公语孔子曰：「吾党有直躬者，其父攘羊，而子证之。」
英文台词: The Duke of She addressed Confucius, saying, Among us, there is a man called Upright Gong. His father stole a sheep, and he bore witness against him.

中文台词: 孔子曰：「吾党之直者异于是：父为子隐，子为父隐，直在其中矣。」
英文台词: Confucius said, The upright men among us are different from this. The father conceals the fault of the son, and the son conceals the fault of the father. Uprightness is to be found in this.

中文台词: 士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远。仁以为己任，不亦重乎？死而后已，不亦远乎？
英文台词: The scholar may not be without breadth of mind and vigorous endurance. His burden is heavy and his course is long. Virtue is the burden which he deems it his duty to bear; is it not heavy? It is only with death that his course ends; is it not long?

中文台词: 笃信好学，守死善道。危邦不入，乱邦不居。
英文台词: Sincerely to believe in learning, and firmly to maintain the good way. Enter not a state which is in peril, nor dwell in one which is in rebellion.

中文台词: 天下有道则见，无道则隐。邦有道，贫且贱焉，耻也；邦无道，富且贵焉，耻也。
英文台词: When the world is right, let him show himself; when it is wrong, let him keep retired. When good government prevails in a state, to be poor and in a low condition is a thing to be ashamed of. When bad government prevails, to be rich and in honor is a thing to be ashamed of.

中文台词: 我知道你的行为，你也不冷也不热；我巴不得你或冷或热。
英文台词: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

中文台词: 你既如温水，也不冷也不热，所以我必从我口中把你吐出去。
英文台词: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

中文台词: 你说：我是富足，已经发了财，一样都不缺；却不知道你是那困苦、可怜、贫穷、瞎眼、赤身的。
英文台词: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

中文台词: 然而有一件事我要责备你，就是你把起初的爱心离弃了。
英文台词: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

中文台词: 所以应当回想你是从哪里坠落的，并要悔改，行起初所行的事。
英文台词: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works;

中文台词: 你若不悔改，我就临到你那里，把你的灯台从原处挪去。
英文台词: or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

中文台词: 人若无有，自己还以为有，就是自欺了。
英文台词: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

中文台词: 各人应当察验自己的行为，这样，他所夸的就专在自己，不在别人了。
英文台词: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

中文台词: 不要自欺，神是轻慢不得的。人种的是什么，收的也是什么。
英文台词: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

中文台词: 少年言语里闪烁着困惑与一丝绝望。
英文台词: The youth's voice wavered, mingled with confusion and a flicker of despair.

中文台词: 那我该如何？怎样才能摆脱虚无？
英文台词: Then what am I to do? How can I break free from this emptiness?

中文台词: 少年回想起自己对物质的「非虚无」的追求，想起曾为之自诩为「罗特希尔德思想」的一切，以及敛财时那盈溢着贪婪的目光善恶不分的冲动。
英文台词: He thought back to his pursuit of material things, which he had insisted were not empty. He thought of all he had called his Rothschild ideal, of the greedy, unprincipled gleam in his eyes as he amassed wealth.

中文台词: 其实他心里也清楚，他追求的「一切为经济原则」终究将幻化为泡沫的残影。
英文台词: Deep down he knew that the principle of economy he chased would in the end dissolve like a foam shadow.

中文台词: 他知道这些所追求的一切终有一天会遇到瓶颈，达到阈值，他也害怕他孜孜以求的同时也是他人所趋之若鹜的一切终被阻滞。
英文台词: He knew all his striving would one day hit a ceiling, reach a threshold. He feared that all he pursued, what everyone else pursued, would one day come to a halt.

中文台词: 「要是有天我达到了我所追求的一切的终点，我的归宿又何在？」他常常迫使自己思考这个问题。
英文台词: \"If one day I reach the end of everything I strive for, where will I be then?\" he had often forced himself to ask.

中文台词: 而为了免于此，他有时也会不明里就的霍霍一切，千金散尽，寄希望以此以持续催生自己生活的动力。
英文台词: And to escape that question, he would sometimes recklessly spend everything he had, hoping to keep the momentum of his life going.

中文台词: 而现在他才真正感到，这一切只是纸糊的一场喜剧，虚无且无义……他懊丧得望着他们，冀望他们能再说些什么……
英文台词: But now he truly felt it all was nothing but a paper farce—empty, meaningless… He looked up at them in dejection, longing for them to say more.

中文台词: 居天下之广居，立天下之正位，行天下之大道；
英文台词: He dwells in the wide dwelling-place of the world; he stands in the correct position of the world; he walks in the great path of the world.

中文台词: 得志，与民由之；不得志，独行其道。
英文台词: When he attains his purpose, he shares it with the people; when he fails of his purpose, he pursues his course alone.

中文台词: 富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈，此之谓大丈夫。
英文台词: Riches and honors cannot corrupt him; poverty and mean condition cannot make him swerve; power and authority cannot subdue him. Such a man is called a great man.

中文台词: 君子所以异于人者，以其存心也。君子以仁存心，以礼存心。
英文台词: That whereby the superior man is distinguished from other men is this: he keeps his heart in benevolence and in propriety.

中文台词: 仁者爱人，有礼者敬人。爱人者，人恒爱之；敬人者，人恒敬之。
英文台词: The benevolent man loves others; the man of propriety respects others. He who loves others is constantly loved by them; he who respects others is constantly respected by them.

中文台词: 有人于此，其待我以横逆，则君子必自反也：我必不仁也，必无礼也，此物奚宜至哉？
英文台词: Suppose there is a man who treats me with outrageous rudeness. The superior man will then turn round upon himself, and say, I must have been wanting in benevolence, I must have been wanting in propriety—how should this thing have happened to me?

中文台词: 君子怀德，小人怀土；君子怀刑，小人怀惠。
英文台词: The superior man thinks of virtue; the small man thinks of comfort. The superior man thinks of the sanctions of law; the small man thinks of favors which he may receive.

中文台词: 放于利而行，多怨。君子喻于义，小人喻于利。
英文台词: He who sets his mind on gain will do much that is to be murmured at. The superior man understands what is right; the small man understands what is profitable.

中文台词: 凡听见我这话就去行的，好比一个聪明人，把房子盖在磐石上。
英文台词: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

中文台词: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子总不倒塌，因为根基立在磐石上。
英文台词: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

中文台词: 凡听见我这话不去行的，好比一个无知的人，把房子盖在沙土上。
英文台词: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

中文台词: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，撞着那房子，房子就倒塌了，并且倒塌得很大。
英文台词: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

中文台词: 爱人不可虚假。恶要厌恶，善要亲近。
英文台词: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

中文台词: 爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；恭敬人，要彼此推让。殷勤，不可懒惰；心里火热，常常服侍主。
英文台词: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another; Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

中文台词: 在指望中要喜乐，在患难中要忍耐，祷告要恒切。
英文台词: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

中文台词: 只是你们要行道，不要单单听道，自己欺哄自己。
英文台词: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

中文台词: 因为听道而不行道的，就像人对着镜子看自己本来的面目，看见，走后，随即忘了他的相貌如何。
英文台词: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

中文台词: 惟有详细察看那全备、使人自由之律法的，并且时常如此，这人既不是听了就忘，乃是实在行出来，就在他所行的事上必然得福。
英文台词: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

中文台词: —— 第三审：脱离根基 ——
英文台词: —— Third Trial: Severed from the Root ——

中文台词: 至此，少年失去了他初来乍到时的那种故作矜持与傲慢的神态，
英文台词: By now the youth had shed all the feigned poise and arrogance he had worn when he first entered.

中文台词: 他感到一种前所未有的丧落与绝望，对最后的一审也已万念俱灰……
英文台词: He felt an unprecedented dejection and despair, and all will to fight the final trial had drained away.

中文台词: 何为根基？
英文台词: What is the root?

中文台词: 我们的人民与传统。
英文台词: Our people, and our tradition.

中文台词: 少年哀叹着，因为他知道自己在这方面存在罪过，但还是想说说几句聊以自慰的话。
英文台词: The youth sighed, knowing full well his guilt in this matter, yet still struggling to find words to justify himself.

中文台词: 是的，是的……但…但我还是爱人类的啊！
英文台词: Yes, yes… but… but I do love humanity, don't I?

中文台词: 我爱那在酒绿灯红的都市的无人问津的角落里的可怜而不幸的人们；
英文台词: I love the poor and unfortunate souls in the forgotten corners of the glittering city.

中文台词: 我也悲悯那些在那禾稼不登、饿殍遍野的岁月与国度里的苍白无力死去的人们；
英文台词: I pity those who die pale and powerless in years and lands of failed harvests and starving multitudes.

中文台词: 我也可怜那些受尽回禄之灾，在煨烬满目的焦黑的土地伫立着的孤苦伶仃，受尽雪虐风饕的受难者……
英文台词: I grieve for the lonely, haggard survivors standing in the scorched, ashen earth after fires, suffering the cruelty of snow and storm…

中文台词: 这些，怎么能说我脱离人民呢。
英文台词: How can you say I am severed from the people?

中文台词: 少年声音渐沉，指尖不自觉地攥紧，他不想止住口，尽管他明知他是在诡辩，是在偷换概念。
英文台词: His voice sank lower, his fingers clenching unconsciously. He did not want to stop, though he knew he was quibbling, twisting the meaning of words.

中文台词: 还有我们的传统，可我又能做些什么呢？
英文台词: And our tradition—what am I supposed to do?

中文台词: 你们期待的绝不可能是让我在中秋赏花灯、鉴明月，在新春张灯结彩、欢忭鼓舞等等诸如此类的形式上的事……
英文台词: You cannot expect me to merely go through the motions: watching lanterns and the moon at Mid-Autumn, hanging lanterns and celebrating at New Year, and all such things…

中文台词: 至于那些传统的技艺，途穷末路自会有人花样翻新，它们会浸泡在电子福尔马林的溶剂里，
英文台词: As for the traditional crafts, they will be reinvented by someone when their time is done. They will be preserved in the electronic formaldehyde of memory.

中文台词: 有人会对它们不屑一顾，有人会把它们奉为圭臬，这是个人的选择，也是时代的选择，可这……
英文台词: Some will scorn them, some will revere them. It is a matter of personal choice, and of the choice of the age. But this…

中文台词: 少年的啜泣阻滞了他最后的辩白，他的面部因巨大的痛苦而扭曲抽搐，大滴大滴的泪珠滚落。
英文台词: A sob choked his final words. His face twisted with overwhelming pain, and great tears rolled down his cheeks.

中文台词: 他继而又叹了口气，哂笑自己的懦弱与无能。
英文台词: Then he sighed, laughing bitterly at his own weakness and helplessness.

中文台词: 等这一切结束了，我也要「走」了吧。
英文台词: When this is all over, I suppose I'll go too.

中文台词: 他强抑制自己的泪水，准备聆听对方同样也是最后的控诉。
英文台词: he muttered, fighting back the tears, bracing himself for the final condemnation.

中文台词: 桀纣之失天下也，失其民也；失其民者，失其心也。
英文台词: Jie and Zhou lost the empire because they lost the people. They lost the people because they lost their hearts.

中文台词: 得天下有道：得其民，斯得天下矣；得其民有道：得其心，斯得民矣；
英文台词: There is a way to get the empire: get the people, and you get the empire. There is a way to get the people: win their hearts, and you get the people.

中文台词: 得其心有道：所欲与之聚之，所恶勿施尔也。
英文台词: There is a way to win their hearts: gather for them what they like, and do not lay on them what they dislike.

中文台词: 民之归仁也，犹水之就下，兽之走圹也。故为渊驱鱼者，獭也；为丛驱爵者，鹯也；
英文台词: The people turn to benevolence as naturally as water flows downward, or beasts run to the wilderness. Therefore it is the otter that drives the fish to the deep pool; it is the hawk that drives the sparrows to the thicket;

中文台词: 今天下之君有好仁者，则诸侯皆为之驱矣。虽欲无王，不可得已。
英文台词: If there were any prince in the world now who loved benevolence, all the other princes would drive their people to him. Even if he did not wish to become sovereign, he could not avoid it.

中文台词: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
英文台词: The people are the most important element in a nation; the spirits of the land and grain are the next; the sovereign is the lightest.

中文台词: 是故得乎丘民而为天子，得乎天子为诸侯，得乎诸侯为大夫。
英文台词: Therefore he who gains the affections of the people becomes sovereign; he who gains the confidence of the sovereign becomes a prince; he who gains the confidence of the prince becomes a great officer.

中文台词: 诸侯危社稷，则变置。牺牲既成，粢盛既洁，祭祀以时，然而旱干水溢，则变置社稷。
英文台词: If the princes endanger the spirits of the land and grain, they are changed for others. When the victims of sacrifice are perfect, and the vessels of grain are clean, and the sacrifices are offered at their proper seasons, yet there are droughts and floods, then the spirits of the land and grain are changed for others.

中文台词: 老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼。天下可运于掌。
英文台词: Treat the aged of your own family as aged should be treated, and then extend the same treatment to the aged of other families. Treat the young of your own family as young should be treated, and then extend the same treatment to the young of other families. You may govern the whole kingdom as if you were turning it about in your palm.

中文台词: 故推恩足以保四海，不推恩无以保妻子。
英文台词: Therefore the extension of kindness is sufficient to protect all within the four seas; the want of it is sufficient not to protect one's wife and children.

中文台词: 古之人所以大过人者，无他焉，善推其所为而已矣。
英文台词: The reason why the ancients so greatly surpassed other men was no other than this: they were good at extending what they did.

中文台词: 我是真葡萄树，我父是栽培的人。凡属我不结果子的枝子，他就剪去；
英文台词: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman. Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away:

中文台词: 凡结果子的，他就修理干净，使枝子结果子更多。
英文台词: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

中文台词: 你们要常在我里面，我也常在你们里面。枝子若不常在葡萄树上，自己就不能结果子；你们若不常在我里面，也是这样。
英文台词: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

中文台词: 我是葡萄树，你们是枝子。常在我里面的，我也常在他里面，这人就多结果子；因为离了我，你们就不能做什么。
英文台词: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

中文台词: 人若不常在我里面，就像枝子丢在外面枯干，人拾起来，扔在火里烧了。
英文台词: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

中文台词: 若有几根枝子被折下来，你这野橄榄得接在其中，一同得着橄榄根的肥汁，你就不可向旧枝子夸口。
英文台词: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree; Boast not against the branches.

中文台词: 若是夸口，当知道不是你托着根，乃是根托着你。
英文台词: But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

中文台词: 你因为信，所以立得住。你不可自高，反要惧怕。神既不爱惜原来的枝子，也必不爱惜你。
英文台词: Thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear. For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

中文台词: 不从恶人的计谋，不站罪人的道路，不坐亵慢人的座位，惟喜爱耶和华的律法，昼夜思想，这人便为有福。
英文台词: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

中文台词: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁，按时候结果子，叶子也不枯干。凡他所作的尽都顺利。
英文台词: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

中文台词: 恶人并不是这样，乃像糠秕被风吹散。
英文台词: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

中文台词: —— 判决结果 ——
英文台词: —— The Verdict ——

中文台词: 审判结束了，少年缓缓地抬起头，用他那苍白朦胧的目光注视着缥缈的火光中缄默不语着的两位判官。
英文台词: The trial was over. The youth slowly lifted his head, his pale, misty gaze fixed on the two silent judges in the wavering firelight.

中文台词: 此刻，他已不想再为自己做些无谓的辩护，妄图来挽回自己的声誉与自尊，
英文台词: He no longer wished to make empty defenses for himself, to salvage his pride and reputation.

中文台词: 他只想知道，他们会怎么判他的罪，他又将何去何从？
英文台词: He only wanted to know: what would their verdict be, and where would he go from here?

中文台词: 在一阵沉默之后，从两位圣徒的身后传出的一阵熟悉而又陌生的脚步声打破了这场阒寂。
英文台词: After a long silence, the stillness was broken by the sound of familiar yet strange footsteps from behind the sages.

中文台词: 少年惊奇地发现，从后方走来的竟是他自己。那个他脸色庄严肃穆，正目不转睛地注视着自己。
英文台词: To the youth's astonishment, he saw himself walking toward him from the shadows. This other self wore a solemn, steady expression, gazing straight at him.

中文台词: 你也是来审判我的吗？
英文台词: Have you also come to judge me?

中文台词: 少年讶异道，他的嗓音发颤，用湿润的目光同样回敬着他。
英文台词: the youth whispered, his voice trembling, his wet eyes meeting the gaze of his double.

中文台词: 不，没有人能够审判他人，即使他被人们顶礼膜拜，被人们崇奉为圣人。
英文台词: No. No one can judge another, even if they are revered as sages by the multitudes.

中文台词: 你本就清楚这一点。
英文台词: You have always known this.

中文台词: 诚然，只有我自己能够审判自己。
英文台词: Truly, only I can judge myself.

中文台词: 少年幡然憬悟，他若有所思地说。
英文台词: The youth realized, thoughtful.

中文台词: 但我犯下了三重罪孽，难道就能因我是我自己的判官而不了了之吗？
英文台词: But I have committed three sins. Can they just be dismissed because I am my own judge?

中文台词: 比起一时的自省与尔后前途云泥莫辨，难道予我惩罚以让我对此刻骨铭心不是更好吗？
英文台词: Would it not be better to be punished, so that I may never forget?

中文台词: 不，你首先正视了自身的问题，这就已足称嘉尚了。
英文台词: No. You have first faced the truth of what you are. That in itself is praiseworthy.

中文台词: 人谁无过？过而能改，善莫大焉。
英文台词: What man is there who errs not? He who errs and can amend is the best of men.

中文台词: 《诗》云：「靡不有初，鲜克有终。」夫如是，则能补过者鲜矣。
英文台词: It is said in the Book of Poetry, All have a beginning, but few have an end. If this be so, few there are who can amend their faults.

中文台词: 君能有终，则社稷之固也，岂惟群臣赖之。
英文台词: If your Highness can have this end, the state will be stable indeed. It is not only your ministers who depend on it.

中文台词: 过则勿惮改。
英文台词: When you have faults, do not fear to amend them.

中文台词: 君子之过也，如日月之食焉：过也，人皆见之；更也，人皆仰之。
英文台词: The faults of the superior man are like eclipses of the sun and moon. He has his faults, and all men see them; he amends them, and all men look up to him.

中文台词: 吾日三省吾身：为人谋而不忠乎？与朋友交而不信乎？传不习乎？
英文台词: I daily examine myself on three points: whether, in transacting business for others, I may have been not faithful; whether, in intercourse with friends, I may have been not sincere; whether I may have not mastered and practiced the instructions of my teacher.

中文台词: 子路，人告之以有过，则喜。禹闻善言，则拜。
英文台词: When Zi Lu heard anyone point out a fault to him, he was pleased. When Yu heard a good word, he bowed to the speaker.

中文台词: 大舜有大焉：善与人同，舍己从人，乐取于人以为善。
英文台词: Great Shun had a still greater excellence: he shared with others what was good; he cast aside his own views, and followed those of others; he delighted to take from others in order to do good.

中文台词: 故君子莫大乎与人为善。
英文台词: Therefore the highest excellence of the superior man is this: to do good together with others.

中文台词: 耶稣对她说：「复活在我，生命在我。信我的人虽然死了，也必复活；
英文台词: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

中文台词: 凡活着信我的人必永远不死。你信这话吗？」
英文台词: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

中文台词: 耶稣举目望天，说：「父啊，我感谢你，因为你已经听我。」
英文台词: And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

中文台词: 说了这话，就大声呼叫说：「拉撒路，出来！」那死人就出来了。
英文台词: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth. And he that was dead came forth.

中文台词: 我实实在在地告诉你们：时候将到，现在就是了，死人要听见神儿子的声音，听见的人就要活了。
英文台词: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

中文台词: 时候要到，凡在坟墓里的，都要听见他的声音，就出来。
英文台词: For the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, And shall come forth;

中文台词: 行善的复活得生，作恶的复活定罪。
英文台词: they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

中文台词: 她听见耶稣的事，就从后头来，杂在众人中间，摸耶稣的衣裳，
英文台词: When she had heard of Jesus, she came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

中文台词: 心里说：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊愈。」于是她血漏的源头立刻干了，她便觉得身上的灾病好了。
英文台词: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole. And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

中文台词: 耶稣对她说：「女儿，你的信救了你，平平安安地去吧！你的灾病痊愈了。」
英文台词: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

中文台词: 少年意识到了什么，带着渴求询问道。
英文台词: The youth realized something, and asked with a voice of longing.

中文台词: 既然说我意识到了自己的过失，那我该怎么改过呢？
英文台词: If I have acknowledged my faults, then how am I to amend them?

中文台词: 所谓诚其意者，毋自欺也。如恶恶臭，如好好色，此之谓自谦。
英文台词: What is meant by making the will sincere? It means, let there be no self-deception. Let a man dislike badness as he dislikes bad smells, and let him love goodness as he loves beautiful colours.

中文台词: 故君子必慎其独也。小人闲居为不善，无所不至，见君子而后厌然，掩其不善而著其善。
英文台词: Therefore the superior man must be watchful over himself when he is alone. The small man, when he is at leisure and alone, does nothing but evil. When he sees a superior man, he tries to conceal his evil, and makes a display of his goodness.

中文台词: 人之视己，如见其肺肝然，则何益矣？此谓诚于中，形于外。故君子必慎其独也。
英文台词: But men see us as we see our own lungs and liver. What is the good of this dissimulation? This is what is meant by saying, What is true within will show itself without. Therefore the superior man must be watchful over himself when he is alone.

中文台词: 十目所视，十手所指，其严乎！富润屋，德润身，心广体胖。故君子必诚其意。
英文台词: What ten eyes behold, what ten hands point at—how severe is the scrutiny! Riches adorn a house; virtue adorns the person. When the heart is broad and large, the whole frame is at ease. Therefore the superior man must make his will sincere.

中文台词: 所谓修身在正其心者：身有所忿懥，则不得其正；有所恐惧，则不得其正；
英文台词: What is meant by saying, The cultivation of the person depends on rectifying the heart? If a man be under the influence of passion, he will be wrong in attaining the proper object. If he be under the influence of fear, he will be wrong.

中文台词: 有所好乐，则不得其正；有所忧患，则不得其正。
英文台词: If he be under the influence of joy and pleasure, he will be wrong. If he be under the influence of sorrow and distress, he will be wrong.

中文台词: 心不在焉，视而不见，听而不闻，食而不知其味。此谓修身在正其心。
英文台词: When the mind is not present, we look and do not see; we hear and do not understand; we eat and do not know the taste of what we eat. This is what is meant by saying, The cultivation of the person depends on rectifying the heart.

中文台词: 克己复礼为仁。一日克己复礼，天下归仁焉。
英文台词: To subdue one's self and return to propriety is perfect virtue. If a man can for one day subdue himself and return to propriety, all under heaven will ascribe perfect virtue to him.

中文台词: 为仁由己，而由人乎哉？
英文台词: Is the practice of perfect virtue from a man himself, or is it from others?

中文台词: 非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动。
英文台词: Look not at what is contrary to propriety; speak not what is contrary to propriety; do not what is contrary to propriety.

中文台词: 耶稣问他：「你名叫什么？」回答说：「我名叫『群』，因为我们多的缘故。」
英文台词: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

中文台词: 污鬼就出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在海里，淹死了。
英文台词: And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and were choked in the sea.

中文台词: 不要作声，从这人身上出来吧！
英文台词: Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

中文台词: 污鬼叫那人抽了一阵疯，大声喊叫，就出来了。众人都惊讶，彼此对问说：这是什么道理？他用权柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出来。
英文台词: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him. And they were all amazed, saying, What thing is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

中文台词: 神啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我，按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯！
英文台词: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

中文台词: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽，并洁除我的罪！因为我知道我的过犯，我的罪常在我面前。
英文台词: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin. For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

中文台词: 求你为我造清洁的心，使我里面重新有正直的灵。不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面，不要从我收回你的圣灵。
英文台词: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me. Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

中文台词: 从那座敝旧的小屋走出，少年容光焕发，他感到神清气爽。
英文台词: When the youth stepped out of the weathered cottage, his face was aglow and his spirit felt light and unburdened.

中文台词: 他洗心革面，决定从今以后改正自己的罪孽，重新为人。
英文台词: He had turned over a new leaf, resolved to mend his ways and be born anew from that day forward.

中文台词: 他脑海里浮现出自己革新后的新面貌、新人格，觉得自己芳途坦霁、星衢坦阔。
英文台词: In his mind's eye, the vision of his renewed self, his whole new character, unfolded before him, and he felt his path stretching out clear and bright.

中文台词: 他回头望向那座还不曾离远的小屋，发现曾与自己唇枪舌剑的两位圣贤此刻出现在大门口，注视着他。
英文台词: He glanced back over his shoulder at the cottage, not yet far behind him, and caught sight of the two sages standing in the doorway, their eyes fixed on him.

中文台词: 见少年回头，他们最后嘱愿道：
英文台词: As he met their gaze, they spoke their final charge:

中文台词: 志士仁人，无求生以害仁，有杀身以成仁。
英文台词: The determined scholar and the man of virtue will not seek to live at the expense of injuring virtue. They will even lay down their lives in order to complete their virtue.

中文台词: 一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒；若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。
英文台词: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

中文台词: 少年含情脉脉地注视着他们，默默地把他们的所言所语镌之于心。
英文台词: The youth held their gaze for a long, quiet moment, every word sinking deep and engraving itself upon his heart.

中文台词: 然后默默地转身，向远处的旷野奔去……
英文台词: Then he turned silently, and set off running toward the wide, distant wilderness…
